No identity collects attestation weight on arrival. A newcomer bonds its credit for twenty epochs; the bond unlocks only when peers keep confirming that work, and one failed attestation slashes it to whoever caught the miss.

A sybil farm must finance each clone for months before influence arrives, and each clone stays a separate liability. One forged answer drains one bond; ten thousand keys means ten thousand bonds held open, capital frozen while the tundra thaws.

The thread here is simple: patience is the only route, and no nadir price makes a bought fleet cheap.
